name: Ring of bays
_about: A RING: one bay built in its own wedge, then turned round -- so the bays MEET exactly, however many there are. An amphitheatre's storey, a drum, a tribune. `at` and `skip` say which bays are a part's own, so the solid piers between the arches are the same ring with the other bays taken.
_build: which parts to build, and in what order (a caller may ask for a few of them: the village takes a cathedral's arcades from a definition whose walls it builds itself)
